description: NaGdTiNbO₆F crystallizes in the tetragonal P4_322 space group. Na is bonded to six O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.57 Å) and four longer (2.74 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.24 Å. Gd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six O and two equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.77 Å. Both Gd-F bond lengths are 2.28 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-47°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.02 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-47°. There are four shorter (2.00 Å) and two longer (2.02 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms to form distorted ONa₂Nb₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent FNa₂Gd₂ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FNa₂Gd₂ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Nb₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Gd, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Gd, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Gd and two equivalent Ti atoms. F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Gd atoms to form FNa₂Gd₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent FNa₂Gd₂ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₂Nb₂ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Nb₂ trigonal pyramid.
